xmldoc.short_description: Add schema definitions to a netCDF file.

param_input_item.param_description: Path of the netCDF file to create or update.
Structure describing dimensions, variables, groups, and attributes. The structure can follow the shape returned by ncinfo where applicable.

param_output_item.param_description: This function does not return a value.

description.p: ncwriteschema creates definitions from a schema structure.
Use it to reproduce metadata layout before writing variable data.
